note: YouTube uses OAuth2 authorization-code flow with a localhost-callback browser handshake. The CLI's auth login command is fully implemented (see internal/cli/auth.go) but requires interactive completion (the user navigates to Google's consent screen, then the CLI's callback server receives the code). Cannot be driven from a non-interactive session. User confirmed in Phase 1 that they have OAuth Client ID/Secret/Refresh-Token available — Phase 5 live testing is deferred to the user's own machine via: youtube-pp-cli auth login --client-id <id> --client-secret <secret>, then youtube-pp-cli doctor to verify reachability, then any non-mutating command (mod queue, digest analytics --since 1d) for end-to-end smoke.
